hooks.text: 九位黑化民间传说英雄各有独立玩法，包括狼人小红帽与堕落孙悟空
hooks.excerpt: Play as 9 heroes, each with a unique twist and individual gameplay, including Little Red Riding Hood, who suffers from lycanthropy; Sun Wukong, the fallen monkey king; the Snow Queen with her evil powers; and many other familiar characters who have a darker side and are more violent than you might remember.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 每章只有三天三夜强化角色，时间耗尽就必须迎战章节Boss
hooks.excerpt: You have 3 days and 3 nights to increase your power. Face the chapter boss when you feel ready… or when you no longer have a choice.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 黑暗奇幻氛围与漫画书视觉结合，重塑熟悉童话的阴暗面
hooks.excerpt: Ravenswatch is a meticulously crafted combination of a dark fantasy atmosphere with a comic book style.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 角色绘制、动画与特效表现优秀。

excerpts.excerpt: Excellent drawing, beautiful characters, their animations and effects
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 局内奖励不值得投入整轮时间。

excerpts.excerpt: the rewards don't feel worth the runs.
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 肉鸽玩法失衡，首轮后容易乏味。

excerpts.excerpt: unbalanced roguelite game play that is bland after the first run.
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 网络问题破坏合作体验。

excerpts.excerpt: fails to provide a gratifying co-op experience due to network troubles
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

excerpts.excerpt: 后期构筑也感觉不到有多深
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 游戏缺少关键机制引导

excerpts.excerpt: the game doesn't really help you learn a lot of the really important aspects at all.
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 全局限时机制令人烦躁。

excerpts.excerpt: 有个败笔就是限时的设计，逼着玩家做取舍，就很烦
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

excerpts.excerpt: 角色前期跟残疾人没区别
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 关闭限时会阻止成就和更高难度解锁。

excerpts.excerpt: 如果你选择删掉时间限制，不仅无法解锁成就，连更高难度都无法解锁。
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 战斗与特殊招式令人满足。
